context: Context menu item in the state machine editor that adds a new state at the clicked position
Context menu item that deletes the selected states and transitions in the state machine editor.
Context menu item that pans and zooms the view to fit the current selection.
Display label shown inside the box of the special "any" state, whose transitions can be taken from any other state. This state cannot be renamed; the parentheses indicate it is a special state.
Display label shown inside the box of the special starting state of the state machine. This state cannot be renamed; the parentheses indicate it is a special state.
Toolbar button that leaves the state machine editor and returns to the parent graph. {graphName} is the name of that parent graph.
Toolbar button that adds a new state to the state machine.
Fallback name for the parent graph shown in the 'Back to' button when the parent graph has no name.
Label for the dropdown that chooses the easing curve of a transition.
Button that deletes the transition currently being edited.
Label for the field that sets how long a transition takes, in seconds.
Label for the field that sets a transition's priority; higher-priority transitions are evaluated first.
Title of the panel for editing a transition between two states.
